what_happened: Astra run v1 failed at the second llm.prompt call: openai.PermissionDeniedError 403 'The max estimated cost of operation ($6.7575) exceeds your available quota (based on max_output_tokens)'. First fix attempt with max_output_tokens kwarg then failed with TypeError: Completions.create() got an unexpected keyword argument 'max_output_tokens'.
root_cause: 1) Proxy reserves cost from the request's max output token budget; default budget exceeded remaining benchmark quota. 2) OpenAI SDK chat.completions param is max_completion_tokens, not max_output_tokens (proxy error message uses its own internal name).
what_i_did_wrong: Trusted the proxy's error-message wording instead of the OpenAI SDK parameter name; cost/quota reservation model was unknown before first run.
fix: llm.prompt(..., extra_api_params={"max_completion_tokens": 16000}) on both calls — run then COMPLETED (task v3).
